newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tuan Sing nets S$11 mln from HK property.
newsitem.headline: Tuan Sing nets S$11 mln from HK property.

text.p: Diversified property group Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd of Singapore said it would make a profit of S$11 million from the sale of one floor of a Hong Kong office block to the Sinochem Hong Kong Investment Company.
In a statement issued late on Wednesday, Tuan Sing said it had a provisional agreement to sell the 15th floor of Nine Queen's Road Central for HK$240.1 million.
Tuan Sing bought the 15th and 28th floors of the building earlier this year for HK$161.9 million and HK$179.0 million respectively.

It said that although the initial deposit and final payment in the sale would not be received until 1997, auditors had advised that because the deal had been struck in 1996 the profit from the sale should be accounted for in the financial year ended December 31, 1996.
Tuan Sing said it had yet to decide whether to follow the auditors' advice.
